brief: Wave35 multi-exchange crypto candidate exploration and risk-hardening, paper research only

goals.title: Universe freeze
goals.objective: Enumerate every current Binance and Bitget USDT perpetual contract and persist inclusion or exclusion reason without live-order capability
goals.evidence: Public-only snapshot wrote 1,595 terminal ledger rows (854 Binance, 741 Bitget), 96 history candidates, 4 requests, ledger sha256 157914d6879015991ae95697dec89c70d4f751449bc8477667e533c36a47d9fc; Wave35 tests 16/16 passed.

goals.title: Typed acquisition
goals.objective: Implement and test public market-data adapters, immutable snapshots, and bounded cached candle/funding collection
goals.evidence: Typed public acquisition completed: 96/96 terminal history rows, 1,117 public requests, 46 quality-passed, 50 rejected only for <730 bars, 0 acquisition errors; UTC manifest sha256 89b8d3e63cd8c7956b245af3fe6c4020ec39d08f84cb784727bda222231f4459; deduped panel 27 assets/1,100 UTC days; tests 27/27.

goals.title: Graph search
goals.objective: Run deterministic shared-policy multi-asset search with temporal separation and multiple-testing accounting
goals.evidence: Deterministic graph search evaluated 480 shared policies across 1,009 simulations: seed240 -> leader-neighbour240 -> train rank -> fixed48 validation -> frozen policy lb30-rb7-l2-s2-tv0.50-aw0.40-vc0.60-cc0.65-dd0.20-cd10. Selected train multiple 1.683869 (worst fold 1.171713, MDD -20.6811%); validation multiple 1.185331, MDD -11.4808%; cumulative trials 5,468 and DSR 0.0; artifact sha256 61bdfc08278706c8a81e42b4faa7ba8cadacac5b719eab6248d152235fd1b232; tests 30/30.

goals.title: Risk hardening
goals.objective: Apply portfolio concentration, volatility, funding, fee, gap, correlation, and venue-shock gates
goals.evidence: Risk hardening found rebalance-only breaker failure (abrupt MDD -74.7376%, 0.275578x), added daily drawdown flattening, reran all 480 candidates, and froze lb30-rb7-l2-s4-tv0.35-aw0.40-vc0.60-cc0.80-dd0.20-cd10. New 2025H2 base 1.300623x/MDD -15.1255%; all 14 path gates pass with 0 liquidations, worst abrupt MDD -33.1576%, worst combined 0.684220x; only global failure is validation DSR 0<0.95. Artifact sha256 605e4c2fe7c796740d1ff5c1e7ce7aa0ce0264b8b0a211d0705e6a10d34eb8ce; tests 33/33.

goals.title: Independent validation
goals.objective: Reproduce artifacts, run tests and quality checks, obtain Luna Max review, and assemble Fable audit packet
goals.evidence: Post-holdout Luna audit found 2 HIGH and 1 MEDIUM blockers. All were structurally remediated and targeted Luna review passed, but the consumed holdout cannot be rerun. Canonical final/validation/OMX surfaces are invalidated; historical final SHA 01e84e00859ad89709826cd4f395c79166551b9aa5cdf3b6d13c7dc4cc462a12 is audit-only. Current decision research_only and strategy_approved=false.
goals.verify_evidence: Expected fail-closed before holdout simulation: holdout_attempt_contract_mismatch; canonical passed=false; 86 tests passed; Luna remediation PASS.
